_comment: Approved official P&G sources for the weekly P&G AI News job. Only pages under allowed_url_prefix can be published. LinkedIn is manual-only (no public feed; scraping violates its terms). pginvestor.com blocks automated clients, so earnings releases come from the SEC copies (8-K Exhibit 99). Earnings calls: P&G publishes no transcript itself, so the third-party transcript at StockAnalysis (data by Quartr) is used. It is free, plain HTML and allowed by robots.txt. Only P&G speakers' turns are quotable.

sources.name: Earnings call transcript (StockAnalysis, data by Quartr)
